title: 29 U.S.C. 256 (Portal-to-Portal Act: when a collective action is commenced for each claimant)
publisher: Office of the Law Revision Counsel, U.S. House of Representatives (uscode.house.gov)
claims: Section 256 provides that, for the purposes of section 255, an action under the Fair Labor Standards Act is considered commenced on the date the complaint is filed.

Section 256 provides an exception for a collective or class action under the Fair Labor Standards Act: it is considered commenced for an individual claimant on the date the complaint is filed only if the claimant is specifically named as a party plaintiff and the claimant's written consent is filed on that date, and otherwise on the subsequent date on which the claimant's written consent is filed in the court.
